scope: Independent runtime/PCM/registered-voice and precise audio-follow review only; UI/session/backup/native acceptance remains separate.
contracts: Zero pacing uses the original split_utterances and preserves the selected settings object; empty default session behavior is outside this review.
Nonzero engine calls clear only locally assembled pacing fields; generic Python helper still receives the exact original six ordered settings fields.
New boundaries are deterministic source punctuation/newline/blank-line/form-feed rules; highest-specificity co-located boundary wins, including explicit zero suppression.
Unsigned PCM8 uses128; signed16/24/32 silence uses zero bytes. Frames round by (milliseconds*rate+500)//1000, with byte admission before writing silence.
Bounded preflight caps10000 chunks and3600000 extra milliseconds before creating output or calling an engine; mid-silence and boundary preparation remain cancellable.
Existing native causal-owner retention of utterance and staging directory is unchanged.
Measured pause map has strictly increasing source offsets and nonempty in-range half-open PCM spans; audio-follow holds the prior word during inserted silence and remains approximate within speech.

meaningful_cases: Actual8/16/24/32-bit mono/stereo PCM and unchanged UTF-8 text/hash.
11025Hz x20ms and44100Hz x5ms each yield221 frames.
Boundary priority, explicit zero suppression, long blank run, chunk/aggregate/output limits.
Cancellation during actual silence blocks and preparation before any engine call.
Actual registered Flite concatenation compared with separately rendered selected-voice speech.
Current registered-SAPI adapter with explicitly modeled low-level PCM; exact rate/volume/budget mapping and pre/post registration checks.
Actual selected-range focus positions and malformed/unrelated map rejection.

limitations: No speech quality, linguistic alignment, model inference or acoustic/native SAPI qualification is inferred from the synthetic cases.
